Each item names the source PDF, the published value, and a precondition on the stored value. Apply only to a scratch DB with scripts/corrections/apply_corrections.py; production promotion requires review.

flagged_not_applied.reason: Raw text holds '56.05' and no standalone '6.05' token, matching the leading-5 defect, but the OCR table on p22 is garbled ('NewPoIefH') and the row/column binding to 'Metal Halide - Area - New Pole' was not confirmed visually. Needs a rendered-page check.

Title/filename say 'eff. 2024-04-01'; the PDF text and parsed rider say 'Effective for service rendered on and after April 1, 2025' (TOTAL 1.950c/kWh, matches bills 2025-04..2025-11). Data is correct; metadata label is wrong. Cosmetic.

Published RDM residential for service on/after April 1, 2025 = 0.232c/kWh (hd 48 PDF; leaf-600 2025-04-01 summary line 'RDM 0.232 4/1/25'). The 2026-05-11 DB held both vid 5415 (hd 48, 0.00232) and vid 5414 (hd 368, 0.00252). hd 368 is the current-site ry1 PDF whose text says 'on and after April 1, 2026' but is stored as 2025-04-01. The late-May (family, effective_start) dedup kept 5414 and dropped the correct 5415. Proposed: re-date hd 368 / vid 5414 to 2026-04-01 and restore a 2025-04-01 version on hd 48 with 0.00232 $/kWh. Not applied: re-dating changes version selection for every consumer and needs review. No effect on the 12-bill reconciliation path (which prices riders from the leaf-600 summary).

hd 370 (leaf-no-610-rider-pim-ry1.pdf) text: 'Effective for service rendered on and after April 1, 2026', 0.005c/kWh; stored effective_start 2025-04-01. Published 2025-04-01 PIM (leaf-600 2025-04-01 summary) = 0.002c/kWh, which no current version holds. Same misdating pattern as F3 (already present in the 2026-05-11 DB).

Version 6649 (effective 2024-12-01) is now bound to hd 5365 (E-2 Sub 1275, 'Effective ... on and after December 1, 2021', stored 2021-06-01) and holds residential 0.00482. Published JAA residential effective 12/1/24 = 0.538c/kWh (leaf-600 2025-04-01 summary). On 2026-05-11 the same version pointed at an E-2 Sub 1354 bundle with 0.00464 (the 2026 rate). Neither binding is the 2024-12-01 JAA sheet; needs the correct source document.
